title: Bureau of Indian Standards (Hallmarking of Gold Jewellery and Gold Artefacts) Order, 2020

clauses.title: Phases of Mandatory Hallmarking Implementation
clauses.text:
Mandatory hallmarking implementation phases:
- Phase 1 (June 16, 2021): Mandatory hallmarking enforced in 256 districts across India.
- Phase 2 (June 2022): Extended to additional districts.
- Phase 3 (April 2023): Mandatory hallmarking now applicable in ALL districts of India.

Who must comply: All jewellers selling gold jewellery/artefacts must register with BIS and sell only hallmarked gold jewellery.
Penalties for non-compliance:
- First offence: Fine up to ₹1 lakh
- Subsequent offences: Fine up to ₹5 lakh and/or imprisonment up to 1 year
- Selling jewellery below declared purity: Action under BIS Act 2016 — fine up to 10 times the value of goods or ₹1 lakh minimum
